2026-08-01 | ST-13 | conversion.py | `_read_pdf` checks `doc.needs_pass` before calling to_markdown, and names `pymupdf.FileNotFoundError` as its own except clause | an encrypted PDF OPENS without error in pymupdf 1.28.0 and even answers `page_count`; only `needs_pass` reveals it, and without the check pymupdf4llm dies on an undeclared `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable` mid-batch, over exactly the file PRD §11 requires be reported as one Failed row. Separately `pymupdf.FileNotFoundError` SHADOWS the builtin and subclasses RuntimeError, so `except OSError` does not catch a missing PDF -- it was falling into the last-resort catch and logging a traceback for an ordinary mid-sync race

Either would be reported Added, embedded, and one day cited to a user as a source: a silent poisoning of the index that no exception announces
